protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: At the BIC, prepareForLogin() writes a fresh challenge only into the by-reference local key JSON, while Frontend/WebAuthnController::prepareLogin() returns without setWebAuthnKeys(); registration stores key and id without challenge; authenticate() checks the stored challenge only when isset(), so the absent property skips replay rejection and the caller also fails to persist the burned challenge. The published vendor advisory independently describes this capture-replay mechanism.

findings: The primary record identifies the correct vulnerability mechanism, smallest surviving public introducer, immediate parent, direct fix, and affected/fixed release boundary.
